description: Ministry of Defence - Revoked the Ex. Gaz. No. 2271/38 of 18.03.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the awarding of the President's and University Colours to the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University. This content does not involve government structural changes (Type 1), personnel appointments (Type 2), or hybrid government matters (Type 3). It also does not fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal/regulatory, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial/law enforcement). As an honorary award presentation to an educational institution, it falls under miscellaneous administrative matters.
